text:
Maria V: heads-up: DeployBot suppressed an auto-rollback on the canary because the signal was marked low-confidence. can we decide manual abort vs continue?
DeployBot: [auto-action suppressed] Reason: noisy p95 spike + low sample count. Suggested: monitor 15m. Flags: canary=v3.12.1, traffic=5% :warning:
Chen (infra): saw the metric spike too, but traces are mixed. if p95 > 250ms AND errors > 0.5% sustained for 5m => abort. otherwise keep canary running and increase sampling.
Ops Lead: @Maria V what's the customer-facing risk? do we need to pin older model?
Maria V: no immediate error reports yet. some retries on background jobs. leaning conservative because this is a model kernel change.
Jake: if we abort, we should pin to v3.11.8 (last stable). I'll draft release note blurb.
Sarah: recommend open support ticket and notify customers on the 99% list if we abort. also suggest short maintenance banner if we plan the rollback window.
Chen (infra): rollback CLI ready. steps:
```
# run as deploy-ops
deployctl promote --target-tag v3.11.8 --scope canary
deployctl drain --pool canary --timeout 60s
deployctl rollout --strategy immediate --pool canary
```
Ops Lead: timeline? if we decide abort, we execute within next 10m. who will run commands?
Maria V: I can run commands and coordinate comms. @Jake will post updated release notes. @Chen run post-rollback sanity checks.
Jake: drafting short note: "We observed increased latency on canary for v3.12.1; we've rolled traffic back to v3.11.8 for stability while we investigate kernel perf. No customer data affected." will post to #release-notes and TOC.
DeployBot: manual rollback authorized by ops - pending execution. Use `deployctl rollback --canary --to v3.11.8` to initiate.
Ops Lead: ok let's do manual abort. Maria please execute and confirm. Chen & Jake, standby for validation and comms.
Maria V: executing now -> running `deployctl rollback --canary --to v3.11.8` :arrow_down:
Maria V: drain step completed, promoting v3.11.8 to canary.
Chen (infra): watching telemetry — p95 dropping back to baseline within 90s. KV cache warmup showing normal rates.
Jake: posted release note and internal comms, pinged support on the ticket.
Sarah: setting banner: "Brief maintenance: rolling back canary for stability. Expect no downtime."
Maria V: rollback finished, monitoring 10m. will update thread when green. :white_check_mark:
Ops Lead: thanks team. postmortem follow-up scheduled if regression persists.
Maria V: noted — creating a short incident doc and assigning to Chen + runtime team.
DeployBot: action complete: manual rollback executed by Maria V at 6165001265.
Maria V: thread closed for now, will reopen if anything pops up.
